data.text:
Biotech is no longer incremental.
Survival doubled in pancreatic cancer, gene edits rewrote disease, mRNA beat standards, 28% weight loss, AI drug hit Phase 3, pig kidney lasted 271 days.
Biology is becoming software.
AbCellera, CRISPR, Prime & Schrödinger are writing the code.

Join us this Friday, Oct. 30, starting at noon in Genentech Hall, Byers Auditorium for the Annual Faculty Research Symposium. Lunch in the Atrium, then eight faculty talks, from music & hearing to CRISPR in head and neck cancer, a poster session & poster awards. https://t.co/0a6P6TIcuX
